name: verkit-grey
description: Shared Rich terminal theme for tables and panels across this developer's Python CLIs (task-agent, multi-agent-registry, ...). Source of truth is src/verkit/theme.py (the Theme dataclass); this JSON mirrors Theme.DEFAULT for non-Python consumers and is kept in sync by tests/test_theme.py.

adoption.python: from verkit.theme import DEFAULT as theme
adoption.note: Opt-in only: verkit publishes the theme but never applies it for you.
